params.note: platform-bugs #76: the SIGNING HOST alone loses its chain (host-chain-cut.ts). Twice per game, from the game's chain times: just before the Register tap (registration open, at least 60 s left after the window) and two turns before the confirm stage (the report filed inside the window). Each time truapi-host's established sockets to the People RPC are killed (ss -K) and its new connects refused for 45 s (cgroup v2 + iptables -m cgroup), then the probes watch the rest of the 60 s window for whether it reconnects; its follow subscription coming back on its own is what the persona finds out. On app=local the browser reads the chain over its own socket (NEXT_PUBLIC_PEOPLE_WS) and netem.sh proves that socket survives: the #76 split. On the DEPLOYED app (dim2.testnet) the app reads THROUGH the host (getHostProvider), so a cut would take its reads too: there the journey drops both cuts and the persona is INCONCLUSIVE, never proven. The confirm cut fires when the page shows the second-to-last turn, two turns (24 s) before the confirm stage; votes are local, so no turn needs the host's chain. In force a few seconds later, its 45 s refusal reaches about confirm + 21 s, past the app's auto-confirm report build at about confirm + 9 s, and the bot's Confirm tap waits until it is in force. Two checks are live from the devLog: the first report attempt ("report built") came after the cut was in force, and no "restart card shown" fell inside the round (unchecked on a build without #491/#492's chain check). The sign-up must show the restart card or HOST_CHAIN_NOTICE under a dead host (#507); see signUpRestartCardCheck in host-chain-cut.ts.
